dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Little Chard, I think you're getting smarter. You actually pick out useful treasures from the trash now!

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Hmph, I'm a thousand times smarter than you.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oops, I was wrong. It's your arrogance that's been skyrocketing. Maybe I should take that flower back. Looks like someone is getting a bit too big for their britches.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: I won't let you! And it's not a flower!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah it is! It's the one I put on you last time.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Well, I won't let you take it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Because it makes me smart!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aino! Hehe, whatcha doing?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, hey! Perfect timing! I'm playing a game, hehe. Wanna join?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ineffa didn't want to play with you?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh no, she did! She loves playing with me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, then where is she?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Save... me...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: This is Ineffa's favorite game: "Cling Clang: Aino Takes Flight." She says it helps expand her horizons and exercise her joints!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, she's calling for help!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Oh, that's just for fun! Here, watch this.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa, time to go home!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: No... I want to keep playing...

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Ineffa, quiz time. What's the difference between a domestic duck and a wild duck?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: One is domestic and one is wild.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Bingo! You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Okay, here's another one. What's the difference between those two and Knuckle Duckle?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Knuckle Duckle is a duck with knuckles?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Wrong! Wild ducks and domestic ducks are ducks, but Knuckle Duckle isn't.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I see. Then, are robots people?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Of course not!

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Oh, so I'm not a person.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: You're Ineffa. The one and only Ineffa. My Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Just like I'm the one and only Aino. Your Aino.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Understood.
